v1.note: P is one design four times: the same dark or light rounded card with a mode tab pill, a thick ring around the time, a Start/Reset/Skip row, dots and three minute inputs. Q varies in layout (centered blue, left-aligned mono, full-bleed red) but is all giant-numeral typography, mostly with a linear bar, with two near-identical blue ones. R spans a ring dial, a tiny near-bare mono layout, a huge mono numeral and a tab-pill page, so it differs most in scale and way of showing time, though two entries are still similar.

v2.note: P has a left-aligned mono page and a full-bleed red one, but P3 and P4 are both centred navy with big cream digits. Q mixes a ring dial, a tiny mono text page, a navy full-bleed and a cream pill-tabs page, with one navy centred overlap. R is one design four times: a rounded card with tabs, a ring, Start/Reset/Skip and three dots, differing only in light or dark and ring thickness.

v3.note: P mixes a sparse monospace text page, a cream ring dial, a huge numeral with progress bar, and a full-bleed navy slab, though P2 and P3 share a palette; Q is one dark rounded card with a coral ring, tab pills and the same controls four times; R varies in palette and layout (red full-bleed, left-aligned mono editorial, navy) but R3 and R4 are near-twins and all are big numeral with checkboxes.

v1.note: P is one design four times: a centered night-sky dome with a cabin, pines and a wood base, with only day versus night and a few control tweaks differing. Q splits into two dome-plus-side-panel pages and two shelf-room scenes (a daylight room, a candlelit room), but the cabin is constant. R varies the most, with a chapel in a blurred room, a light blue dome, a dark oversized globe and a blue panel layout, though it is still mostly cabin and glass dome.

v2.note: P: two shelf-room scenes (books, plant, candle/lamp) and two dark studio shots with a side control panel, all with the same cabin-and-firs inside; some variety in setting but the globe content repeats. Q: a real spread in palette and composition (dark minimal, blurred-room chapel with a green base, bright daylight blue, navy panel layout) and one different scene (chapel), though the cabin still recurs. R: all four are a centered night cabin with moon, firs and chimney smoke in a dark navy globe with a wood base and a pill control row below, so it reads as one design made four times.

v3.note: P mixes a chapel in a blurred room with three cabin globes in different layouts (full-bleed dark, split panel, minimal day) and base styles; Q is the same centered cabin globe with a brown base and a button row beneath, differing mainly in day or night; R has two shelf-room scenes (candle at dusk, daytime window) and two dark side-panel layouts, with more varied composition but the same cabin or lighthouse content and two near-twins.
